resources.string: Eleven new trackable objects: probes, space telescopes, Tiangong, Apophis, 3I/ATLAS, M87* and Proxima b.
NASA/JPL ephemerides drive moving probes and small bodies, including distance and daily sky paths.
Hubble and Tiangong use recent orbital elements and SGP4, with an alternative data source.
Distant-object directions and missing data are explained explicitly, without invented measurements.
New external WebP images retain individual downloads, integrity checks and offline caching.
Updated credits and translations; graphics releases now provide individual files without duplicate texture ZIPs.
